verdict.rationale: Munito AI's own marketing states a default zero-data-retention posture with no training on customer data. That addresses retention directly, but it is a fixed vendor policy, not documented user-facing controls for setting retention or triggering deletion. Regional processing (EU/US hosts) is data residency, not retention control, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention settings, documented deletion mechanisms (API/console), detailed retention policy docs, independent verification of the zero-retention claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Private by default, zero data retention. No training on your data.
